meta.title: Performance Optimizer
meta.description: Collects per-event and host-wide CPU / memory / IO metrics and exposes them via the Settings → Plugins detail page, an optional HUD, and an MCP server.

actions.openProfilerTip: Tip: capture a renderer profile from this panel when scroll lag spikes.

tool.title: Performance Optimizer — host report
tool.description: Return a fresh performance snapshot from the running Host: rss, heap, cpu (user/system), sample count, last-10 history. Use when investigating scroll lag, memory drift, or tool-loop storms.

mcp.snapshot: Return the most recent host performance sample (rss / heap / cpu / uptime). Lightweight.
mcp.history: Return the last N samples (default 10, max 60) so you can see trend over time.
mcp.reset: Reset the rolling history on the Host. Returns confirmation.
